title: The Treaty of Madrid and the Guaraní War
dek: Of how two crowns redrew South America on a map, traded seven Jesuit missions for a smuggling port, and sent armies when the Guaraní refused to leave.

panels.label: Crowns Told It
panels.text: Each side should keep what it held, along rivers and mountains, and the old papal line was dead letter. A clean border would bring peace.

panels.label: Evidence Allows
panels.text: Portugal wanted the gold country and the mission lands; Spain wanted Colonia closed to smugglers. The people on the ceded land were not asked.
